marketing_description: The DeWALT DCS785B Double Bevel Sliding Miter Saw features a 12 in steel blade with 60T and bevel gear transmission, allowing for precise miter and bevel cuts. This cordless tool, part of the MAX XR Series, includes regenerative braking technology and integrated wireless tool control. It can cut up to 14 in horizontally and up to 6-1/2 in baseboard standing up.
